 Home Education Today News CAT 2026 admit card released by IIM Indore, exam on Nov 29 CAT 2026 admit card released by IIM Indore, exam on Nov 29
 IIM Indore has released the CAT 2026 admit card on the official website. Candidates must verify their details and carry a printed copy for the November 29 examination.
 advertisement To access the CAT 2026 admit card, candidates will have to log in using their registered user ID and password (Image: iimcat.ac.in) India Today Education Desk New Delhi, UPDATED: Nov 6, 2026 16:12 IST The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore on November 6 released the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 admit card. Candidates who have registered for the MBA entrance examination can now download their hall tickets through the official website, iimcat.ac.in.
 To access the CAT 2026 admit card, candidates will have to log in using their registered user ID and password. The admit card contains important details, including the candidate’s name, registration number, photograph, examination centre, allotted test slot and reporting time.
 advertisement Read More IIM Indore will conduct CAT 2026 on November 29 at multiple examination centres across the country. The examination will be held in three sessions. Candidates are advised to download their admit cards at the earliest and carefully check all the details mentioned on the document.
 CAT 2026 ADMIT CARD: HOW TO DOWNLOAD
 Visit the official website, iimcat.ac.in.
 Click on the registered candidate login link.
 Enter the registered user ID and password.
 Submit the login credentials.
 The CAT 2026 admit card will appear on the screen.
 Download the hall ticket and take a printout for future reference.
 CAT 2026 EXAM TIMINGS
 The CAT 2026 examination will be conducted in three sessions on November 29. The examination timings are as follows:
 Slot 1: 8:30 am to 10:30 am
 Slot 2: 12:30 pm to 2:30 pm
 Slot 3: 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm
 advertisement Candidates should note that their allotted examination slot and reporting time will be mentioned on their respective admit cards.
 DETAILS TO CHECK ON CAT 2026 ADMIT CARD
 After downloading the hall ticket, candidates must verify all the details printed on it. These include their name, registration number, photograph, signature, examination centre address, test slot and reporting time.
 In case of any discrepancy in the details, candidates should contact the examination authorities for clarification.
 Candidates must carry a printed copy of their CAT 2026 admit card along with the prescribed photo identity proof to the examination centre. Entry to the examination hall will be subject to the required document verification.
